title: Classic Cornish Pasty
description: A traditional British dish originating from Cornwall, filled with beef, potatoes, and vegetables, wrapped in a crumbly pastry.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine beef, potatoes, onion, and carrots. Mix well.
In a separate bowl, combine cottage cheese and a pinch of salt. Mix well.
Roll out the pastry dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Place the beef mixture in the center of the pastry, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Place the cottage cheese mixture on top of the beef mixture.
Brush the edges of the pastry with a little water.
Fold the pastry over the filling, pressing the edges to seal.
Use a knife to create a few slits in the top crust to allow steam to escape.
Brush the top crust with a little milk or beaten egg for a glaze.
Bake for 40-50 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and the filling is hot and bubbly.
